title: Galatians Chapter 5 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Galatians chapter 5 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Galatians Chapter 5 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Galatians Chapter 5.

questions.question: In Galatians 5, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free
Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing
A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump
Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
questions.correctAnswer: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:1 is the first verse in the chapter and contains this command.

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:2, what will happen if you are circumcised?
options: You shall be justified by the law
You shall be free from the law
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:2 states that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

questions.question: What is every man who is circumcised a debtor to do, according to Galatians 5:3?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:3 says every man that is circumcised is a debtor to do the whole law.

questions.question: What happens to those who are justified by the law, according to Galatians 5:4?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:4 states that whosoever are justified by the law are fallen from grace.

questions.question: Through what do we wait for the hope of righteousness, according to Galatians 5:5?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:5 says we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:6, what is of value in Jesus Christ?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:6 states that faith which worketh by love is what availeth in Jesus Christ.

questions.question: What did the Galatians do well before being hindered, according to Galatians 5:7?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:7 says ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:8, from whom does this persuasion not come?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:8 states this persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

questions.question: What effect does a little leaven have, according to Galatians 5:9?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:9 says a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

questions.question: What does Paul exhort believers to do regarding the liberty Christ has given, in Galatians 5:1?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:1 commands to stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free.

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:4, what has Christ become to those justified by the law?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:4 states Christ is become of no effect unto you if ye are justified by the law.

questions.question: True or False: Galatians 5:5 says we wait for righteousness by faith through the Spirit.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:5 states we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

questions.question: True or False: Galatians 5 teaches that circumcision is necessary for salvation in Christ.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:2 and 5:6 teach that circumcision profits nothing in Christ, only faith which worketh by love is of value.

questions.question: True or False: According to Galatians 5:3, being circumcised obligates a person to keep the entire law.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:3 says every man that is circumcised is a debtor to do the whole law.

questions.question: True or False: Galatians 5:9 says that a little leaven purifies the whole lump.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:9 says a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump, not that it purifies it.

medium.title: Galatians Chapter 5 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Galatians Chapter 5 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What does Galatians 5:10 say about those who trouble the believers?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:10 states that 'he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment,' indicating that those who cause trouble will face consequences.

questions.question: What does Galatians 5:11 suggest will happen if Paul preaches circumcision?
options: The offense of the cross will cease
questions.correctAnswer: The offense of the cross will cease
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:11 indicates that if Paul preaches circumcision, then 'the offence of the cross ceased,' implying that the message of the cross is offensive to those who rely on works.

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:12, what does Paul wish for those who trouble the believers?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:12 expresses Paul's strong desire that those who trouble the believers 'were even cut off,' showing his frustration with false teachings.

questions.question: What does Galatians 5:13 encourage believers to do with their liberty?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:13 states that believers should use their liberty 'by love serve one another,' highlighting the practical application of freedom in Christ.

questions.question: In Galatians 5:14, what is said to fulfill the law?
options: Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself
questions.correctAnswer: Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:14 indicates that 'all the law is fulfilled in one word,' which is the command to love one's neighbor, summarizing the essence of the law.

questions.question: What warning does Galatians 5:15 provide about interpersonal conflict?
options: Not to bite and devour one another
questions.correctAnswer: Not to bite and devour one another
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:15 warns that if believers 'bite and devour one another,' they should take heed, as this could lead to mutual destruction.

questions.question: What does Galatians 5:16 instruct believers to do?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:16 encourages believers to 'Walk in the Spirit,' which is crucial for overcoming sinful desires.

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:17, what is the relationship between the flesh and the Spirit?
options: They are contrary to each other
questions.correctAnswer: They are contrary to each other
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:17 explains that 'the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh,' highlighting the internal conflict faced by believers.

questions.question: What is the implication of being led by the Spirit according to Galatians 5:18?
options: You are not under the law
questions.correctAnswer: You are not under the law
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:18 states that 'if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law,' indicating the freedom that comes from following the Spirit.

questions.question: If a believer is called to liberty, what should they not do according to Galatians 5:13?
options: Use liberty for an occasion to the flesh
questions.correctAnswer: Use liberty for an occasion to the flesh
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:13 warns believers not to use their liberty as an opportunity for the flesh but instead to serve others in love.

questions.question: What does Galatians 5:6 say about the value of faith?
options: Faith is only for the circumcised
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:6 emphasizes that 'faith which worketh by love' is what truly matters in Christ, transcending the significance of circumcision.

questions.question: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump, as stated in Galatians 5:9, implies what about false teachings?
options: They can influence the entire community
questions.correctAnswer: They can influence the entire community
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:9 illustrates that a small amount of false teaching ('a little leaven') can corrupt the whole group, indicating the danger of allowing such influences.

questions.question: True or False: Galatians 5:10 shows that Paul has confidence in the believers.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:10 expresses Paul's confidence in the believers, indicating his belief that they will remain true to their faith.

questions.question: True or False: Galatians 5:11 suggests that Paul is free from persecution if he preaches circumcision.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:11 implies that Paul continues to suffer persecution, indicating that preaching circumcision would not free him from it, but rather would cease the offense of the cross.

questions.question: True or False: According to Galatians 5:12, Paul desires for those who trouble the believers to be corrected.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:12 shows that Paul wishes for those troubling the believers to be cut off, indicating a desire for severe consequences rather than correction.

hard.title: Galatians Chapter 5 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Galatians Chapter 5.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a work of the flesh in Galatians 5:19-21?
questions.explanation: Jealousy is not listed among the works of the flesh in Galatians 5:19-21; instead, 'envyings' is used in verse 21 to describe a similar concept.

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:21, what is the consequence for those who practice the works of the flesh?
options: They shall not inherit the kingdom of God
They shall be given second chances
questions.correctAnswer: They shall not inherit the kingdom of God
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:21 states clearly that those who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT part of the fruit of the Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22-23?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:22-23 lists the fruit of the Spirit and 'pride' is not included; instead, humility or meekness is mentioned.

questions.question: What does Paul say about the law in relation to the fruit of the Spirit in Galatians 5:23?
options: Against such there is no law
Such fruit is against the law
The law strictly enforces the fruit
questions.correctAnswer: Against such there is no law
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:23 states that against the fruit of the Spirit there is no law, indicating that these virtues are in harmony with the law.

questions.question: According to Galatians 5:24, what have those who belong to Christ done with the flesh?
options: Crucified the flesh with affections and lusts
Purified the flesh by works of the law
questions.correctAnswer: Crucified the flesh with affections and lusts
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:24 clearly states that those who are Christ's have crucified the flesh with its affections and lusts.

questions.question: In Galatians 5:26, Paul warns against which of the following behaviors?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:26 warns believers not to be desirous of vain glory, nor to provoke or envy one another.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'μακροθυμία' (makrothymia) in Galatians 5:22 mean?
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'μακροθυμία' used in Galatians 5:22 translates to 'longsuffering,' signifying patience and endurance.

questions.question: Which literary device is primarily used in Galatians 5:19-21 in listing the works of the flesh?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:19-21 uses cataloging by listing a series of works of the flesh, grouping them in a comprehensive enumeration.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage is echoed by the command in Galatians 5:14, 'Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself'?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:14 quotes Leviticus 19:18, which commands loving one’s neighbor as oneself, fulfilling the law.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage complements the teaching in Galatians 5:16 on walking in the Spirit to not fulfill the lust of the flesh?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:5-6 complements Galatians 5:16 by contrasting living according to the flesh versus the Spirit and the resulting peace.

questions.question: What immediately precedes Paul's statement in Galatians 5:24 about crucifying the flesh?
options: The listing of the fruit of the Spirit
The warning that those who practice the works of the flesh shall not inherit the kingdom of God
The command to stand fast in liberty
The teaching about circumcision and the law
questions.correctAnswer: The warning that those who practice the works of the flesh shall not inherit the kingdom of God
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:24 follows the warning in verse 21 about those who do such things not inheriting the kingdom of God.

questions.question: How does Paul contrast the works of the flesh and the fruit of the Spirit in Galatians 5:19-23?
options: By listing the sinful behaviors versus the virtues produced by the Spirit
By describing two types of laws
By emphasizing physical strength versus spiritual weakness
By comparing old covenant and new covenant rituals
questions.correctAnswer: By listing the sinful behaviors versus the virtues produced by the Spirit
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:19-23 contrasts works of the flesh—sinful behaviors—with the fruit of the Spirit—Godly virtues produced in believers.

questions.question: Which theological concept is illustrated in Galatians 5:24 regarding crucifixion of the flesh?
options: Union with Christ in His death
questions.correctAnswer: Union with Christ in His death
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:24 illustrates the theological concept of union with Christ in His death, as believers 'crucify the flesh' with its passions.

questions.question: True or False: Galatians 5:25 encourages believers to live in the Spirit and also walk in the Spirit.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:25 explicitly states, 'If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit,' encouraging consistent spiritual conduct.

questions.question: True or False: In Galatians 5:26, Paul instructs believers to provoke one another as a sign of spiritual zeal.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:26 advises against provoking one another or envying one another, promoting unity rather than conflict.

theological.title: Galatians Chapter 5 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Galatians Chapter 5 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Galatians 5:1 teach about Christian liberty and salvation?
options: Christ has set believers free from legalistic bondage and they must stand firm in that liberty
Salvation is achieved through strict adherence to the law
Christian liberty allows believers to sin without consequence
Liberty in Christ is only a future hope, not present reality
questions.correctAnswer: Christ has set believers free from legalistic bondage and they must stand firm in that liberty
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:1 instructs believers to stand fast in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free and to not be entangled again with the yoke of bondage, emphasizing freedom from legalism.

questions.question: What doctrine about justification is taught in Galatians 5:4?
options: Justification by the law nullifies grace and results in falling from grace
Justification is only through works of the law
Justification is temporary and can be lost by sin
Justification depends on both faith and circumcision
questions.correctAnswer: Justification by the law nullifies grace and results in falling from grace
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:4 states that if anyone is justified by the law, Christ is of no effect to them and they have fallen from grace, teaching justification by faith apart from law.

questions.question: What doctrine about the role of faith and works in salvation is taught in Galatians 5:6?
options: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision avails, but faith working through love is what matters
Faith alone is sufficient without any expression of love
questions.correctAnswer: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision avails, but faith working through love is what matters
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:6 teaches that external works like circumcision do not count for salvation, but faith expressing itself through love is what truly matters.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Galatians 5:5 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:5 highlights that through the Spirit we wait for the hope of righteousness by faith, demonstrating God's providential hopefulness for believers.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Galatians 5:22 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: The fruit of the Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22 begins with love, reflecting God's fundamental attribute of love demonstrated through the Spirit's work.

questions.question: How does Galatians 5:13–14 connect to the broader biblical theme of the law and love?
options: It summarizes the law as fulfilled in loving one’s neighbor, echoing Jesus’ teaching in the Gospels
It rejects the Old Testament law entirely
It teaches that love is a lesser commandment than the law
It asserts that liberty allows for selfishness rather than love
questions.correctAnswer: It summarizes the law as fulfilled in loving one’s neighbor, echoing Jesus’ teaching in the Gospels
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:14 states that the whole law is fulfilled in the command to love one’s neighbor as oneself, connecting to Jesus’ teaching in Matthew 22:37-40.

questions.question: How does the contrast between flesh and Spirit in Galatians 5:16–17 prepare for Pauline theology on sanctification elsewhere?
options: It anticipates Romans 8’s teaching on the conflict between flesh and Spirit in the believer’s life
It denies any conflict between flesh and Spirit
It teaches that flesh and Spirit are the same
It says believers will always yield to the flesh
questions.correctAnswer: It anticipates Romans 8’s teaching on the conflict between flesh and Spirit in the believer’s life
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:16-17’s teaching on flesh lusting against the Spirit parallels Romans 8's description of the ongoing spiritual conflict in the Christian life.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Galatians 5:24 and 5:25 teach about sanctification?
options: Believers crucify the flesh and live by walking in the Spirit, demonstrating active sanctification
Crucifying the flesh means complete sinlessness in this life
Walking in the Spirit is optional for believers
questions.correctAnswer: Believers crucify the flesh and live by walking in the Spirit, demonstrating active sanctification
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:24 states that those in Christ have crucified the flesh, and 5:25 exhorts believers to walk in the Spirit, showing the dynamic of sanctification.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal truth do Galatians 5:19 and 5:22 teach about the nature of the flesh versus the Spirit?
options: The works of the flesh produce death and exclusion from God's kingdom, whereas the fruit of the Spirit leads to life and righteousness
Both flesh and Spirit produce similar results in believers
The flesh’s works are acceptable if motivated by love
The Spirit’s fruit is irrelevant to salvation
questions.correctAnswer: The works of the flesh produce death and exclusion from God's kingdom, whereas the fruit of the Spirit leads to life and righteousness
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:19-21 lists works of the flesh that prevent inheriting God’s kingdom, while 5:22-23 lists fruit of the Spirit that are against the law, highlighting opposing outcomes.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is taught by the synthesis of Galatians 5:2 and 5:6 regarding the law and faith?
options: Circumcision and law-keeping do not justify; faith working through love is the basis of justification
Faith alone without love is sufficient for salvation
questions.correctAnswer: Circumcision and law-keeping do not justify; faith working through love is the basis of justification
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:2 warns that circumcision profits nothing, and 5:6 emphasizes faith expressing itself through love, teaching justification by faith, not law.

questions.question: Skeptics claim Galatians 5:19-21 promotes moral legalism by listing fleshly works. What does this passage actually teach?
options: It warns that those who practice such works will not inherit the kingdom of God, emphasizing ethical holiness
It says these works are permissible for Christians
It lists sins but does not connect them to salvation
questions.correctAnswer: It warns that those who practice such works will not inherit the kingdom of God, emphasizing ethical holiness
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:19-21 explicitly states that those who do such fleshly works will not inherit the kingdom of God, underscoring the necessity of holiness.

questions.question: What doctrine regarding Christian unity and love does Galatians 5:15 teach?
options: Discord and hostility among believers lead to mutual destruction, opposing the unity the Spirit calls for
Conflict among believers is unavoidable and acceptable
Believers should separate from all who disagree
Love is less important than doctrinal purity
questions.correctAnswer: Discord and hostility among believers lead to mutual destruction, opposing the unity the Spirit calls for
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:15 warns that biting and devouring one another causes believers to be consumed one by another, emphasizing the danger of disunity.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is demonstrated by God’s judgment promised in Galatians 5:10?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:10 states that those who trouble the believers will bear judgment, manifesting God's attribute of justice.

questions.question: What theological doctrine does Galatians 5:18 teach regarding the believer's relationship to the law when led by the Spirit?
options: Being led by the Spirit means believers are not under the law's condemnation
The law remains the primary rule for believers
The Spirit leads believers back to strict law observance
Law and Spirit are identical in function
questions.correctAnswer: Being led by the Spirit means believers are not under the law's condemnation
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:18 teaches that if one is led by the Spirit, he is not under the law, signifying freedom from law's condemnation through the Spirit's guidance.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Galatians 5:7 and 5:8 teach about spiritual leadership and false teachers?
options: False teachers introduce persuasion that does not come from God and hinder believers from obeying the truth
All teachings, even false ones, come from God
Believers should ignore persuasion and only trust tradition
Obedience to the truth is irrelevant
questions.correctAnswer: False teachers introduce persuasion that does not come from God and hinder believers from obeying the truth
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:7 questions who hindered believers from obeying the truth, and 5:8 clarifies that the persuasion causing this does not come from the one who calls them, referring to God.
